name: stance
description: basic muay thai stance and guard

name: footwork
description: Movements front, back left, right, diagonal, pivots, ...

name: JAB
description: The jab is a quick snapping strike.

name: CROSS
description: The cross is a power strike and should be fast and hard.

name: HOOK (LEFT)
description: The left hook can be used as a fast and snapping strike or power strike.

name: HOOK (RIGHT)
description: The right hook can be used as a fast and snapping strike or power strike.

name: LOW JAB
description: The low jab is the same as the regular jab technique, but drop eye-level by bending both knees substantially while advancing and striking.

name: LOW CROSS
description: The low cross is the same as the regular cross technique, but drop eye-level by bending both knees substantially while striking.

name: LOW HOOK (LEFT)
description: The low hook is the same as the regular hook left technique, but drop eye-level by bending both knees substantially while striking.

name: LOW HOOK (RIGHT)
description: The low hook is the same as the regular hook right technique, but drop eye-level by bending both knees substantially while striking.

name: UPPERCUT (LEFT)
description: The left uppercut is a fast snapping strike.

name: UPPERCUT (RIGHT)
description: The right uppercut is a fast snapping strike.

name: HORIZONTAL ELBOW (LEFT)
description: The left horizontal elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: HORIZONTAL ELBOW (RIGHT)
description: The right horizontal elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: DOWN ELBOW (LEFT)
description: The left down elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: DOWN ELBOW (RIGHT)
description: The right down elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: UP ELBOW (LEFT)
description: The left up elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: UP ELBOW (RIGHT)
description: The right up elbow is a fast snapping strike.

name: SPINNING BACK-FIST (LEFT)
description: The left spinning back-fist is a fast power strike using centrifugal force.

name: SPINNING BACK-FIST (RIGHT)
description: The right spinning back-fist is a fast power strike using centrifugal force.

name: SPINNING BACK-ELBOW (LEFT)
description: The left spinning back-elbow is a fast power strike using centrifugal force.

name: SPINNING BACK-ELBOW (RIGHT)
description: The right spinning back-elbow is a fast power strike using centrifugal force.

name: JUMP FLY CROSS (LEFT)
description: The left jump fly cross is a power strike used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with Added momentum.

name: JUMP FLY CROSS (RIGHT)
description: The right jump fly cross is a power strike used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with Added momentum.

name: JUMP FLY ELBOW (LEFT)
description: The left jump fly elbow is a power strike used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with Added momentum

name: JUMP FLY ELBOW (RIGHT)
description: The right jump fly elbow is a power strike used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with Added momentum.

name: LEFT ROUND KICK
description: The left round kick is a fast power strike.

name: RIGHT ROUND KICK
description: The right round kick is a fast power strike.

name: LEFT MIDDLE KICK
description: The left middle kick is a fast power strike.

name: RIGHT MIDDLE KICK
description: The right middle kick is a fast power strike.

name: LEFT LOW KICK
description: The left low kick is a fast power strike.

name: RIGHT LOW KICK
description: The right low kick is a fast power strike.

name: LEFT ANGLE KICK
description: The left angle kick is a quick, snapping strike.

name: RIGHT ANGLE KICK
description: The right angle kick is a quick, snapping strike.

name: LONG TEEP
description: The long TEEP is a pushing technique or a quick thrusting strike.

name: SHORT TEEP
description: The short TEEP is a pushing technique or a quick thrusting strike.

name: LONG KNEE (LEFT)
description: The left long knee is a power strike.

name: LONG KNEE (RIGHT)
description: The right long knee is a power strike.

name: JUMP FLY KNEE (LEFT)
description: The left jump fly knee is a power strike and used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with added momentum.

name: JUMP FLY KNEE (RIGHT)
description: The right jump fly knee is a power strike and used to close the distance between you and the target while striking with added momentum.

name: PARRY (LEFT)
description: The left parry is a quick defense against a cross.

name: PARRY (RIGHT)
description: The right parry is a quick defense against a jab.

name: COVER HIGH (LEFT)
description: The left cover high is a defense against high attacks to the center and left side of the head.

name: COVER HIGH (RIGHT)
description: The right cover high is a defense against high attacks to the center and right side of the head.

name: BODY BLOCK OUTSIDE (LEFT)
description: The left cover low outside is a defense against attacks to the left side of the torso.

name: BODY BLOCK OUTSIDE (RIGHT)
description: The right cover low outside is a defense against attacks to the right side of the torso.

name: BODY BLOCK INSIDE (LEFT)
description: The left cover low inside is a defense against attacks to the front midsection.

name: BODY BLOCK INSIDE (RIGHT)
description: The right cover low inside is a defense against attacks to the front midsection.

name: CUP/CATCH (LEFT)
description: The left cup/catch is a defense against the jab or cross and can be altered as a defense against uppercuts.

name: CUP/CATCH (RIGHT)
description: The right cup/catch is a defense against the jab or cross and can be altered as a defense against uppercuts.

name: SLIP (LEFT)
description: The left slip is a defense against the jab or cross.

name: SLIP (RIGHT)
description: The right slip is a defense against the jab or cross.

name: DUCK
description: The duck is a defense against most attacks to the head.

name: BOB AND WEAVE (LEFT)
description: The left bob and weave is a defense against high attacks to the center and left side of the head.

name: BOB AND WEAVE (RIGHT)
description: The right bob and weave is a defense against high attacks to the center and right side of the head.

name: SHOULDER STOP (LEFT)
description: The left shoulder stop is a defense against the cross and right hook.

name: SHOULDER STOP (RIGHT)
description: The right shoulder stop is a defense against the left hook.

name: ELBOW JAM (LEFT)
description: The left elbow jam is a defense against opponent’s right horizontal, right down, and right up elbow.

name: ELBOW JAM (RIGHT)
description: The right elbow jam is a defense against opponent’s left horizontal, left down, and left up elbow.

name: PUSH (LEFT)
description: The left push is used to create distance and disrupt opponent’s strikes.

name: PUSH (RIGHT)
description: The right push is used to create distance and disrupt opponent’s strikes.

name: LEAD LEG SHIELD
description: The lead leg shield is a defense against opponent’s mid or low kicks.

name: CROSS SHIELD
description: The cross shield is a defense against opponent’s mid-level or low level left round kick.

name: SWEEP/PARRY LEFT ROUND KICK
description: The sweep/parry left round kick is a defense against opponent’s mid-left round kick.

name: SWEEP/PARRY RIGHT ROUND KICK
description: The sweep/parry right round kick is a defense against opponent’s mid-right round kick.

name: PARRY LONG TEEP INSIDE
description: The parry long TEEP inside is a defense against opponent’s long TEEP.

name: PARRY LONG TEEP OUTSIDE
description: The parry long TEEP outside is a defense against opponent’s long TEEP.

name: PARRY SHORT TEEP INSIDE
description: The parry short TEEP inside is a defense against opponent’s short TEEP.

name: PARRY SHORT TEEP OUTSIDE
description: The parry short TEEP outside is a defense against opponent’s short TEEP.

name: PARRY LEFT LONG KNEE INSIDE
description: The parry left long knee inside is a defense against opponent’s left long knee.

name: PARRY LEFT LONG KNEE OUTSIDE
description: The parry left long knee outside is a defense against opponent’s left long knee.

name: PARRY RIGHT LONG KNEE INSIDE
description: The parry right long knee inside is a defense against opponent’s right long knee.

name: PARRY RIGHT LONG KNEE OUTSIDE
description: The parry right long knee outside is a defense against opponent’s right long knee.

name: LEFT ANGLE EVADE KICK
description: The left angle evade kick is a defense against opponent’s left round kick and includes a follow-up strike.

name: RIGHT ANGLE EVADE KICK
description: The right angle evade kick is a defense against opponent’s right round kick and includes a follow-up strike.

name: CATCH KICK (LEFT)
description: The left catch kick is a defense against opponent’s mid right round kick or mid right angle kick.

name: CATCH KICK (RIGHT)
description: The right catch kick is a defense against opponent’s mid left round kick or mid left angle kick.
